series.notes: ELIOS — 'A Brand by Kascon Technologies (Pvt) Ltd' (NOT Kascon Electronics). Official domain eliospk.com (elios.com.pk printed as support email domain is DNS-dead). HQ: Plot 77, Street 10, I-9/2, Islamabad. Likely manufacturer/engineering partner: Sabro Technologies (shared address; app 'Elios – By Sabro' com.sabro.accontroller; sabrotechnology.com 404). Model lines (brochure): wall 1.0T Minima Grey/Blossom; 1.5T Noir Pro/Apex Silver/Alpine White; 2.0T Alpine; floor-standing 2.0T & 4.25T (51K BTU); cassette 2.0T & 4.25T; R-410A; T3 twin-rotary; WiFi. One shared 18-page user manual covers the range — no form-factor-specific tables. SOLE CODE SOURCE = official User Manual PDF 'E/F/H SERIES ERROR' pp. 16–18 (19 codes: E0–E5, F0–F6, H0–H5) on the IoT touchscreen controller (display=controller). Manual publishes code→short label only; causes/solutions are engineering inference (flagged). Gaps: F4 'See List' sub-list unpublished; E4 'ADS' and H4 'IB' acronyms undefined; no service manual / LED-blink / dual-8 tables; no second corroborating source for any code. HARD EXCLUSION: Canadian Elios (Master Group/eliosprotech) service manuals = different region/product line — never merge (they use P-series). Support: WhatsApp +92 333 5981711 · +92 321 8548557 · +92 324 8250610 · +92 308 1911579 · sales@eliospk.com · eliospk.com/support. Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON.

title.en: Room Temperature Sensor Disconnected or Short
title.ur: Room temperature sensor disconnect ya short

meaning.en: Room temperature sensor is disconnected or short-circuited (manual: 'ROOM SENSOR DISCOUNT OR SHORT' — DISCOUNT = typo for DISCONNECT).
meaning.ur: Room temperature sensor disconnect ya short hai (manual: 'ROOM SENSOR DISCOUNT OR SHORT' — DISCOUNT = DISCONNECT ki typo).

causes.ur: Room-sensor plug dhili/na lagi
Sensor wiring tooti ya paani se kharab
Thermistor open/short

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Reseat room-sensor plug; measure resistance vs thermistor curve
solutions.ur: Room-sensor plug dobara lagayein; thermistor curve se resistance naapein

solutions.en: Replace sensor/wiring if out of spec
solutions.ur: Spec se bahar ho to sensor/wiring badlein

title.en: Indoor Coil Icing and/or Indoor Fan Motor Fault
title.ur: Indoor coil icing aur/ya indoor fan motor fault

meaning.en: Manual collapses two faults: indoor coil sensor ice condition and/or indoor fan motor fault ('INDOOR COIL SENSOR ICE/MOTOR_FAULT').
meaning.ur: Manual do faults ek string mein deti hai: indoor coil sensor ice condition aur/ya indoor fan motor fault.

causes.en: Clogged filter / low airflow causing evaporator freeze-up
causes.ur: Ganda filter / kam airflow se evaporator jam
Gas kam hone ka ishara

causes.en: Failed/dragging indoor fan motor or obstructed blower
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kharab ya blower block
Fan-tach feedback open

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Clean filters and blower; thaw coil if iced; verify fan spins freely with tach feedback
solutions.ur: Filter aur blower saaf karein; coil par barf ho to pighal dein; fan freely ghoome aur tach feedback ho, check karein.

solutions.en: If motor fault recurs: technician replaces fan motor/PCB drive
solutions.ur: Motor fault baar baar aaye to technician fan motor/PCB drive badle
